# WASMOS Value Constants

Values a peer passes or interprets, generated from `abi/constants.yaml` into C, Rust, Go, Zig and AssemblyScript.

## net_socket_family

Address family of a socket: which layer it addresses and therefore what an
address means. Independent of the socket type below, as in BSD sockets.

AF_PACKET is the link layer and its payload is a complete ethernet frame,
destination MAC first. It is the only family that can carry a protocol
below IP -- ARP being the reason it exists -- and it pairs only with RAW.
The value matches Linux's AF_PACKET so the number is not a fresh invention
a reader has to look up.

| Symbol | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NET_SOCKET_AF_INET` | 2 | IPv4. |
| `NET_SOCKET_AF_INET6` | 10 | IPv6. |
| `NET_SOCKET_AF_PACKET` | 17 | Link layer; payload is a whole ethernet frame. RAW only. |

## net_socket_type

Delivery discipline of a socket. STREAM and DGRAM run over a protocol above
IP, so they require an AF_INET/AF_INET6 socket; RAW carries frames the
caller frames itself and requires AF_PACKET. net-stack refuses any other
pairing of the two axes.

| Symbol | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NET_SOCKET_STREAM` | 1 | Reliable byte stream (TCP). |
| `NET_SOCKET_DGRAM` | 2 | Datagrams (UDP). |
| `NET_SOCKET_RAW` | 3 | Whole ethernet frames, header included. AF_PACKET only. |

## net_socket_open_flags

net_socket_open_descriptor_v1_t.flags bits.

Flag bits: members are OR-able rather than alternatives.

| Symbol | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NET_SOCKET_OPEN_FLAG_TLS` | 0x1 | Stream socket is wrapped in TLS (altcp_tls). |

## net_socket_limits

Sizes and versions both sides of a socket must agree on. They are ABI, not
private choices: a client that sizes a buffer from a different number
silently loses data the peer thinks it delivered.

| Symbol | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NET_SOCKET_OPEN_DESCRIPTOR_VERSION` | 1 | Version of net_socket_open_descriptor_v1_t. |
| `NET_SOCKET_SNI_MAX` | 256 | Capacity of the SNI / certificate-verification hostname in the open descriptor. A DNS name is at most 253 bytes; the extra room leaves space for the NUL mbedtls_ssl_set_hostname needs. |
| `NET_PACKET_FRAME_MAX` | 2048 | Largest ethernet frame carried over a packet socket, in bytes. net-stack refuses a longer frame in either direction, and a client reading into anything smaller sees frames skipped. Generous next to the 1514-byte classic MTU so a jumbo-ish frame is not truncated. |

## net_udp_datagram

Framing of one datagram record inside a UDP socket ring: this header,
immediately followed by payload_bytes of payload.

| Symbol | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NET_UDP_DATAGRAM_RECORD_VERSION` | 1 | Record version. |
| `NET_UDP_DATAGRAM_FLAG_DESTINATION` | 1 | Record carries explicit destination fields (an unconnected sendto). |

## net_ifaddr

Interface address records, as reported by NET_IPC_IFADDR_LIST.

| Symbol | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NET_IFADDR_RECORD_VERSION` | 1 | Record version. |
| `NET_IFADDR_FLAG_LINK_UP` | 1 | The link itself is up (carrier present). |
| `NET_IFADDR_FLAG_ADMIN_UP` | 2 | The interface is administratively enabled. |
| `NET_IFADDR_FLAG_DHCP` | 4 | Address is (or is being) assigned by DHCP. |
